To do: read #301 (read-only) and correct, in feat/credentials-vault only, the text of the spec (and the PR #161 body if it repeats it) so it describes what #301 actually does. Change only these descriptions: no code, no test, no new case, unless a test asserts this text. Merge from main, never force-push. Push to the same branch and get every CI check green on the last commit. If the evidence (docs/reliability/credentials.md R21) cites a commit, leave it as is if no code or test changed.

Done when: the spec and #161's body no longer say 'stateful' or 'vault-refresher' for the vault, and they describe #301 as it is; CI green on the last commit; still a draft.

Out of scope: everything else. Report: new SHA, CI run URL, the diff of the changed lines.

Same gap on the #162 side (feat/credentials-previews): its spec says the `previews-refresher` works 'as vault-refresher', but no vault-refresher exists in infra-k8s #301 (90-day token minted by hand). Fix this wording in #162 so the previews refresher is described on its own (what it does: every 5 minutes, writes Secret previews-session, from previews-client), without depending on a vault-refresher. If #162 also contains the vault text you just fixed in #161 (shared spec), keep the two branches consistent with each other, each still mergeable alone into main.

No code, no test, no new case. Merge from main if needed, never force-push. Push, CI green on the last commit, still a draft. The revocation text stays as it is (already consistent with Pocket-ID 2.18.0).

Report: new SHA, CI run URL, the diff of the changed lines.

dev-1 has just changed only the text of the agora spec in #161 (feat/credentials-vault) and #162 (feat/credentials-previews), so it describes what #301 does (stateless, no vault-refresher, 90-day token minted by hand) and the previews refresher on its own. Read the new heads of these two branches (read-only).

Check: (1) that the contract (packages/credentials and the route/client/token part of docs/specs/credentials.md) still matches #301 and #303; (2) whether the agora pins in the e2e workflows of #301 (929f96b) and #303 (b887ae1) are still faithful.
